Notes.tldr: Adds percent-off discount codes: one code per cart, checked against a hardcoded list (case-insensitive, expiry, minimum subtotal). Exposed through POST /cart/discount. The minimum is checked only when the code is applied. Free shipping still goes by the pre-discount subtotal.

reading_order.Summary: Discount type, error values, the three live codes, case-insensitive lookup.
ApplyDiscount, Savings and the new Total; the minimum is checked only at apply time.
Table tests at a pinned Oct 1, 2026, plus a test that a new code replaces the old.
New takes a clock; new route maps errors to 404/422; view adds code/savings.
Pinned clock; tests a successful apply plus the 422 and 404 errors.
Documents the endpoint and how codes work.

cart/cart.go::(*Cart).ApplyDiscount.does: Checks code is known, unexpired and the cart meets its minimum, then stores it.
cart/cart.go::(*Cart).ApplyDiscount.changed: New. A failed apply leaves any existing code on the cart.

cart/cart.go::(*Cart).Discount.does: Returns the cart's code and whether one is set.

cart/cart.go::(*Cart).Savings.does: Subtotal times PercentOff / 100, rounded down; zero with no code.
cart/cart.go::(*Cart).Savings.changed: New. Doesn't recheck the minimum after items are removed.

cart/cart.go::(*Cart).Total.changed: Now subtracts Savings; shipping still uses the pre-discount subtotal.

cart/discount.go::day.does: Returns midnight UTC on the given date.
cart/discount.go::day.changed: New. Codes expire at the start of the listed day.

cart/discount.go::lookupCode.does: Finds a code in the hardcoded list, ignoring case and surrounding spaces.

cart/discount_test.go::TestApplyDiscount.does: Table: percent off, any case, below minimum, expired, unknown, plus shipping.
Applies WELCOME10 then BOOKWORM20; expects BOOKWORM20 to stay.

server/server.go::(*Server).applyDiscoun.does: Decodes {code}, applies it: 400 bad body, 404 unknown, 422 otherwise.

server/server.go::New.does: Builds a Server with a catalog and an empty cart map.
server/server.go::New.changed: Now takes a now func() time.Time clock argument.

server/server.go::view.changed: Adds code and savings fields, both left out when empty.

server/server_test.go::TestApplyDiscount.does: Applies bookworm20 to a $64 cart; expects savings 1280, total 5120.

server/server_test.go::TestDiscountError.does: Checks a below-minimum code gets 422 and an unknown code gets 404.
server/server_test.go::TestDiscountError.changed: New. No endpoint test for an expired code.

server/server_test.go::newShopper.does: Builds a test server and a client that keeps the cart cookie.

contract_changes.Title: New POST /cart/discount {"code"}: 200 with cart view, 400, 404 or 422.
Cart JSON gains optional `code` and `savings`, left out when empty or zero.
server.New(cat) becomes server.New(cat, now func() time.Time); breaks existing callers.
New exported Cart.ApplyDiscount/Discount/Savings, Discount type and three Err* values.
